grab data-sites list
```{r read-site-list}
sites_list <- read.csv(here::here(params$file), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


Grab chemistry and pcode data (this will likely be used later in the analysis)

```{r get-chemistry-and-pcode-data}
chem<-fetch::fetch_chem(output = "standard")
chem$V1.x<-NULL
chem$X.y<-NULL
chem$V1<-NULL
chem$V1.y<-NULL
chem$X.x<-NULL
chem$V1.x<-NULL

chem<-chem %>%
  distinct()

field<-fetch::fetch_field(path = "L:/BWAM Share/data/streams/cleaned_files",
                        output = "standard")

metrics<-fetch::fetch_bugs(path = "C:/Users/kareynol/OneDrive - New York State Office of Information Technology Services/Streams Data Modernization/Cleaned Files",output = "standard")

```


```{r subset-data-to-sites-list}

sites.l<-unique(sites_list$SMAS_ID)

```


```{r subset-chem}

chem2<-chem %>%
  subset(CHS_EVENT_SMAS_HISTORY_ID %in% sites.l)

```

Subset to Dates function-we have the list of sites/dates. One question-do we do an average of BAP at a site (if it's been visited a couple times?) or do we do JUST the BAP found at the sampling date?

```{r}

sites_list$filter_match <- paste(sites_list$SMAS_ID,
  sites_list$YEAR,
  sep = "_"
)

chem3<-chem2 %>%
  filter(CHR_VALIDATOR_QUAL != "R") %>%
  mutate(date=as.Date(CHS_EVENT_SMAS_SAMPLE_DATE,"%m/%d/%Y"),
         year=format(date,"%Y"),
         filter_match=paste(CHS_EVENT_SMAS_HISTORY_ID,
                            year,
                            sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(CHR_RESULT_VALUE = case_when(CHR_VALIDATOR_QUAL %in% "U"~0.5*CHR_METHOD_DETECT_LIMIT,
                                      TRUE~CHR_RESULT_VALUE)) %>% #getting 1/2 the MDL for analysis
  group_by(filter_match,CHEM_PARAMETER_NAME,CHEM_PARAMETER_UNIT_NOSP,CHEM_PARAMETER_FRACTION) %>%
  summarise(median=median(CHR_RESULT_VALUE,na.rm = TRUE))

chem_joined <- merge(sites_list,
  chem3,
  by = "filter_match"
)

#same thing for the insitu
insitu.df<-field$insitu

insitu2<-insitu.df %>%
  mutate(date=as.Date(ISWC_EVENT_SMAS_SAMPLE_DATE,"%m/%d/%Y"),
         year=format(date,"%Y"),
         filter_match=paste(ISWC_EVENT_SMAS_HISTORY_ID,
                            year,
                            sep = "_")) %>%
  group_by(filter_match,ISWC_CHEM_PARAMETER_NAME) %>%
  summarise(median=median(ISWC_RESULT,na.rm = TRUE))

insitu_joined <- merge(sites_list,
  insitu2,
  by = "filter_match"
)

metrics.df<-metrics

metrics.final <- metrics.df %>%
  mutate(
    YEAR = format(MSSIH_EVENT_SMAS_SAMPLE_DATE, "%Y"),
    filter_match = paste(MSSIH_EVENT_SMAS_HISTORY_ID,
      YEAR,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )
# join the metrics to the final sites file with the wgt

metrics_joined <- merge(sites_list,
  metrics.final,
  by = "filter_match"
)
unmatched <- anti_join(sites_list,
  metrics.final,
  by = "filter_match"
)
```

RUN THE SPSURVEY!!
So it looks like these files need to have a projection assigned and be an sf object?

We also need to assign the weight back to the COMID or the EPA ID to get that for the analysis to run.


```{r state-wide-conditions, fig.width=10}
chloride<-chem.sf %>% 
  filter(CHEM_PARAMETER_NAME == "CHLORIDE")

chloride<-chloride %>% 
  mutate(chloride_cat = case_when(median > 100 ~ "Impacted",
                                  median >70 & median < 100~"Med-impacted",
                                  median >50 & median < 70~"Non-impacted",
                                  median <50 ~ "Pristine",
                                  TRUE~"error"))
chloride_ests<-spsurvey::cat_analysis(
  dframe = chloride,
  vars = "chloride_cat",
  siteID = "SMAS_ID",
  weight = "adj_wgt"
)



ggplot2::ggplot(chloride_ests, aes(x=factor(chloride_ests$Category), y=chloride_ests$Estimate.P)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=chloride_ests$Category)) +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=factor(chloride_ests$Category), y=chloride_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=chloride_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=chloride_ests$UCB95Pct.P), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  # ggpattern::geom_crossbar_pattern( aes(x=factor(chloride_ests$Category), y=chloride_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=chloride_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=chloride_ests$UCB95Pct.P), size = 0.5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= chloride_ests$LCB95Pct.P, 
                    ymax= chloride_ests$UCB95Pct.P),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.5)+
  coord_flip()



```

```{r state-wide-conditions, fig.width=10}
do<-insitu.sf %>% 
  filter(ISWC_CHEM_PARAMETER_NAME == "DISSOLVED_OXYGEN")

do<-do %>% 
  mutate(standard_cat = case_when(median > 8.5 ~ "Supporting",
                                  median >6 & median < 8~"Mildly close",
                                  median < 6~"Not Supporting",
                                  TRUE~"error")) %>% 
  filter(adj_wgt >0)
standard_ests<-spsurvey::cat_analysis(
  dframe = do,
  vars = "standard_cat",
  siteID = "SMAS_ID",
  weight = "adj_wgt"
)



ggplot2::ggplot(standard_ests, aes(x=factor(standard_ests$Category), y=standard_ests$Estimate.P)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=standard_ests$Category)) +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=factor(standard_ests$Category), y=standard_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=standard_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=standard_ests$UCB95Pct.P), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  # ggpattern::geom_crossbar_pattern( aes(x=factor(chloride_ests$Category), y=chloride_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=chloride_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=chloride_ests$UCB95Pct.P), size = 0.5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= standard_ests$LCB95Pct.P, 
                    ymax= standard_ests$UCB95Pct.P),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.5)+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = "Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)")



```
